profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m currently a Senior Software Engineer Staples Promotional Products, a company focused on building software in an agile environment using Lean principles and Kanban. Developer team building and collaboration are key components in the development process, as we value the benefits of sharing knowledge and ideas throughout the development lifecycle. The primary platforms are Microsoft .Net, Angular and IBM iSeries (AS/400), using the latest technologies.

Before joining Staples Promotional Products, I worked for Integrity Inspired Solutions, a consulting company geared toward helping clients adapt a Agile approach to software development. 

Before joining Integrity Inspired Solutions, I worked for Fred Pryor Seminars, an industry leader in business training providing both online training and public seminars. During my twelve years at Pryor as a software engineer, I developed many applications and assumed many roles, as the company transformed from a waterfall development style to a Lean Agile approach, using Kanban.  I was able to compare and contrast the two approaches first hand, and quickly saw the value in engineering software as a closely knitted team. We used the new process to implement Pryor’s training membership application and the web site shopping cart with great success. I developed on both the .Net and iSeries platforms, and had an integral role of unifying the coding practices of the two systems.

I really enjoy developing software with a team striving to work smarter, not harder.  Having a process in place to facilitate good communication and teamwork, is in my view, a basic element to success in any development endeavor!

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked for a client in a developer team of seven individuals, expanding applications to streamline the process for merchandisers doing product presentations to potential customers, and then transforming those items into purchase orders and inventory products. SOA was leveraged to access data from several external systems for presentation, as well as to create orders in the back-end system. As the business priorities changed, my efforts were directed towards the companies web site with a variety of projects. Kanban was used to manage the workflow. Unit tests, integration tests, peer code reviews, and group code reviews were implemented to assure the quality of the code, and to expedite the user acceptance testing of feature development. The technologies used are:

.Net 4.6, C#, VB, Angular 5.5, JavaScript, Jasmine, TypeScript, JQuery, Gulp, Entity Framework, NHibernate, Microsoft Unity, MVVM, WPF, WebForms, Winforms, SOA,  SQL Server 2008, BDD

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked for Fred Pryor Seminars as a senior software engineer. In my twelve years with the company, I was a full stack developer, working on internal applications, customer training web site, shopping cart, and marketing web site. I assisted in the adaptation of a Lean Agile approach to development. We used Kanban for our daily stand-ups. Developed and maintained many applications, including:

• Membership training rewards web site - C#, MVC, Razor view, Knockout JS, JQuery, NHibernate,                 Structure Map, SQL Server 2008
• Shopping cart - C#, MVC, Razor view, Knockout JS, JQuery, NHibernate, Structure Map SQL,Server 2008
• Trainer resources/performance web site - C#, Web forms ASP.Net 3.5,  SQL Server 2008
• Marketing web site - C# Web forms SQL Server 2008
• Product order entry - AS400, RPG IV, SQL
• P.O. - AS400, RPG IV, SQL
• Inventory control management AS400, RPG IV, SQL
